name: Live TV
desc: Watch live TV and channels from your IPTV provider

changes.summary: A tidier TV guide and a softer channel change
points: TV guide: programmes the provider lists on top of each other are laid out side by side, and each time slot shows the programme that started last
Changing channel: the banner and the channel logo fade in and out (needs NotaTV 1.0.13)
Reloading the channel list can no longer play the wrong channel, and on the first start the focus lands on the first group
A new guide address works at once, a very large guide can no longer fill the memory, and holding Yellow changes a favourite only once
